obsah: The atmosphere was relaxed and the participants showed a great desire to improve. For basic technique we didn't worry about who had which bike, and since a few couples signed up too, after agreeing with the riders we combined everything into one day.. As at the first camp, everything here revolved around the bikes and the riders' individual abilities. The goal was to pass on as many skills as possible and help everyone overcome their fear – the progress by the end of the camp was more than visible and everyone deserves praise. Riding and fun were taken care of by Katarína Tóthová and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček.
